Rationale: About 18% of booked places are no-shows.

Requirement: Members can book a class online and cancel it up to 2 hours before it starts.
When a class is full, members can join a waitlist and are moved in automatically when a place frees up.
Members receive a reminder 24 hours before the class.
Trainers see the list of booked members for their class.
Members can rate a trainer after a class.
